Thanks Marissa — great sync this morning. Quick recap from our side and what we need to get the POC kicked off next week: 

Goals / success criteria (high level)
- Validate < 150ms 95th pct latency on 512 token prompts for our support triage flow
- Maintain semantic similarity >= 0.75 vs. our in-house baseline for intent classification
- End-to-end integration with our SSO (Okta) and automated user provisioning for 3 engineers
- No customer data retention beyond session duration (logs allowed for debug)

Scope & timeline
- 3-week evaluation starting Dec 8 (engineering ramp + two test sprints)
- Week 1: access & integration; Week 2: performance testing; Week 3: evaluation & handoff

Access we need from Redwood
- API key (test mode) and example token usage
- IP allowlist ranges for our firewall
- SSO/SCIM invite for an admin and two engineers (okta admin: it-admin@acmecorp.com)

Notes:
- I attached a short requirements sheet with our baseline test queries.
- Can you confirm who on your side will own provisioning and an expected ETA?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of ML 
Acme Corp
